questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

No watch is a bow.

No bow is a tie.

Conclusions:

(I) No watch is a tie.

(II) No bow is a watch.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53f9f79961d268c07ecc4ae32471453f13465e9b75af5d2f95cf2d974d67e6b9.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No watch is a tie.- False (As their is no direct relation between watch and Tie. So,No watch is a tieis may be possible but not definite. Hence, it is false)

(II) No bow is a watch.- True (No watch is a bow. No bow is a watch is True)

Only conclusion (II) follows. 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**

questions.question: 90 people are standing in a row facing north. Mr. Leu is 16th from the right end, while Mr. Sanga is 39th from the left end. How many people are there between Mr. Leu and Mr. Sanga?
questions.solution:
The total number of people is 90, and Mr. Leu is 16th from the right end. The formula to find the position from the opposite end is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7345452d48fb3d9817d4d6157bff6cfe26c99181934389e9e95a56480a189f8e.png] Position from left = Total people − Position from right + 1

Plugging in the values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7345452d48fb3d9817d4d6157bff6cfe26c99181934389e9e95a56480a189f8e.png] Mr. Leu′s position from left = 90 – 16 + 1 = 74 + 1 = 75

So, Mr. Leu is in the 75th position from the left end. 

Now we have the positions of both individuals from the same end (the left end): 

 
• Mr. Sanga's position from the left = 39
 
• Mr. Leu's position from the left = 75 

The number of people between two positions is the difference in their positions minus one.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7345452d48fb3d9817d4d6157bff6cfe26c99181934389e9e95a56480a189f8e.png] People between=Mr. Leu′s position−Mr. Sanga′s position−1

Plugging in the values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7345452d48fb3d9817d4d6157bff6cfe26c99181934389e9e95a56480a189f8e.png] People between=75−39−1=36−1=35

There are 35 people standing between Mr. Leu and Mr. Sanga

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**

questions.question: 43 people are standing in a row facing north. Kumar is 29th from the left end while Mohana is 9th from the right end. How many people are there between Kumar and Mohana?
questions.solution:
To determine the number of people between Kumar and Mohana, first find Mohana's position from the left end of the row. The total number of people is 43, and Mohana is 9th from the right end. 

Mohana's position from left end = Total people - Position from right end + 1

Mohana′s position from left end=43−9+1=35

So, Mohana is 35th from the left end. 

Now that we know both Kumar's and Mohana's positions from the left end, we can find the number of people between them. Kumar is 29th from the left and Mohana is 35th from the left. 

Number of people between = |Mohana's position - Kumar's position| - 1

= (35 – 29) – 1= 6 - 1= 5.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
